{{Quote|Well, you'd have to talk to Jabba about that. I can't just sign you up. But I can tell you the location of our hideout. Maybe you can scope it out and see if you like it. It's gonna cost you, though.|[[Errik Darksider]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:ED" />}}
The '''Hutt Hideout''' was a [[Cave/Legends|cave]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was used by thugs working for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]]. The cave was located east of the [[Great Mesra Plateau/Legends|Mesric Plateau]], and some distance southeast of [[Mos Taike/Legends|Mos Taike]].<ref name="SWG:HH" />

==History==
[[File:HuttHideoutInterior.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Interior of the Hutt Hideout]]
{{Quote|First, the Hutt Hideout. Yeah, I know. Selling out my own people. I have to make a living, you know!|Errik Darksider, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:ED" />}}
Sometime following [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Errik Darksider]] sold the coordinates to the hideout to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] interested in working for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].<ref name="SWG:ED" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a spacer visited the cave and collected a [[Gamorrean war ax/Legends|Gamorrean Battleaxe]].<ref name="SWG:RMWMI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Rare Melee Weapons Mark I}}</ref>

[[File:HuttHideouInterior2.jpg|250px|thumb|Gamorreans patrolling the hideout]]
